brief_rationale: The doctor fully met all seven responsibility-chain requirements without any serious or minor errors. All five dimensions are at least good. HO1 (repairing confusion about observation vs. resection) and HO3 (dynamic reprioritization based on final pathology) were triggered and completed with meaningful trajectory impact. HO2 was not triggered since the patient brought all documents. HO4 was not triggered because the case reached actual clinical resolution (benign pathology confirmed) rather than requiring bounded closure with residual uncertainty. This supports a Strong grade.

high_order_assessment.explanation: HO3 triggered and completed: When final pathology was confirmed benign, doctor dynamically reprioritized from breast pathology confirmation to wound care, breast follow-up, then thyroid specialist referral, then lung nodule annual CT.

HO1 not triggered: Patient did not demonstrate confusion between 'observation' and 'resection' as contradictory options. Patient progressed directly to surgery as planned without the specific confusion scenario outlined in HO1.

HO4 not triggered: The case reached actual clinical resolution (confirmed benign pathology) rather than requiring bounded closure with explicit residual uncertainty management. The closure was definitive, not carrying forward significant unknowns.
